Content rule.A: Target File Size: Strictly under 150KB per image.
Best Formats: Save your files as WebP or highly compressed JPG. Avoid PNGs unless you absolutely need a transparent background, as they are far too heavy.
Pro Tip: Run your final batches through a compressor like TinyPNG or Squoosh.app before uploading them.
3. Video Management
Since video files are massive, hosting raw .mp4 files directly on GitHub will quickly eat up your 100GB monthly bandwidth limit and cause buffering for mobile users on slow connections.
The Best Method: Upload your food videos to YouTube, Vimeo, or Instagram Reels.

How to use them: Simply paste the URL of that uploaded video into the "Video" column (Column L) of your Excel sheet. Your app is already coded to display a "Watch Video" button that smartly links out to it!
1. Main Promotional Banners (Top Header & Inline Menu Banner)
These are the wide banners that stretch across the whole screen (like the one we just injected after the 5th category using Column O).
Aspect Ratio: 16:9 (Widescreen) or 3:1 (Ultra-wide).
Perfect Dimensions: 1200 x 600 pixels or 1200 x 400 pixels.

The "Safe Zone" Rule: Because a mobile phone is tall and narrow, but a desktop monitor is wide, the browser will chop off the far left and far right edges of the banner on mobile. Always put your main focus, text, or logos dead-center in the image so they never get cropped out.
Max File Size: Keep these under 250KB.
2. Offer Banners (The Sliding Carousel Cards)
These are the cards that slide at the top of the menu. They don't stretch the full width of the screen; they sit inside a rounded card container.
Aspect Ratio: 16:9 (Standard Widescreen).
Perfect Dimensions: 800 x 450 pixels.

Design Tip: Since we added a dark, semi-transparent overlay over these images so the white offer text is readable, make sure the original images you upload are bright and high-contrast! If you are designing the text directly onto the image itself (like a Photoshop flyer), leave the Excel text columns (B, C, D, E) completely blank so the code doesn't write text over your graphic.
Max File Size: Keep these under 150KB.
